ordered_branches.explanation: Globally normalizes placeholder strings in CONVERSION_INVENTORY, then deletes all INVENTORY_STAGING and copies selected warehouse fields with fixed stamps/local time and reason/pallet fields mapped to user definitions. Enriches item description/lot flag. Validates warehouse/company/status/base UM, lot/LPN tracking, location existence/activity, missing item, single-item conflicts, duplicate LPN/location/item/lot combinations, multiple lots and location attributes. Missing-item path also marks conversion errors globally. Some LOCATION membership/joins lack warehouse scope; COUNT DISTINCT company ignoresNULL. Multi-location LPN and duplicate-attribute checks use scalar grouped subqueries that can error when multiple offending groups exist. Attribute diagnostics compare attribute IDs to COUNT(*) values, not grouped IDs. Duplicate detection groups include attribute ID in one count but omit it in diagnostic rows. If accumulated validation count>0, marks every staging row USER_DEF1 with fixed failure value; no rollback of replacement/enrichment. Commented validation sections do not execute.
